market.question: Will London have between 10-15mm of precipitation in May?

assessment.reasoning: Heathrow May average rainfall ~50-60mm with high variability. The 10-15mm bucket is well below normal; only dry Mays land here. Base rate for this narrow 5mm window in a single month is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether unsettled forecast translates to total monthly rainfall or scattered showers only.
